messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PAGER PD-18273 - hosted-api-us-west: inference.latency.p99 > 500ms (service=hosted-api). routed to: @Aisha (oncall).
Aisha: Acked. I'm on it — thanks. Any immediate customer reports? :eyes:
Liam: Looking at traces now. p99 spike is very short (30s bursts) and mostly for long-context requests to model-fast-quant. Saw a correlated small KV cache miss rate bump. No 5xxs, just token-generation tail latency.
Jules: FYI autoscaler briefly attempted an upscale but hit soft quota; fallback routing didn't fully activate. I'm toggling routing policy to prefer latency-optimized variants for new requests.
Aisha: Applying routing fallback: prefer model-fast-lowlat for new sessions, and adding stricter batching thresholds to reduce tail. Will monitor.
Liam: Quick dump of metric snippet: ```
# p99 latency (ms)
ts-1811112200: 210
ts-1811112210: 630
ts-1811112220: 180
```
Liam: Also seeing an influx from a handful of IP prefixes in EU hitting our us-west edge (cross-region hop introduced ~120ms). That explains the sharp spikes.
Aisha: Good catch. Jules, can we add a short region-based routing rule while we confirm?
Jules: Adding rule now: "prefer-region: eu -> eu-region-endpoint" (quick patch). Also raising kv-prefill priority for the affected model group.
pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-18273 acknowledged by Aisha. No escalation.
Aisha: Quick customer-impact check: no user-facing errors in logs, only increased tail on a small subset of long sessions. No SLA breach expected. Marking as potentially noisy. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Auto-resolve window: will resolve in 10m if no further pages.
Liam: p99 back down to ~240ms across the cluster after routing rule and kv-prefill. Noise source reduced (traffic shifted to eu endpoints).
Jules: Suppressed noisy alert rule created: inference.latency.p99.noise_group -> suppress for 2m unless sustained. I added a short alert annotation linking to this thread.
Aisha: Agree this was a transient, noisy flap. Filing a short follow-up ticket for longer-term: 1) tighten region routing heuristics, 2) increase kv prefill for warmup on model-fast-quant, 3) review autoscaler soft-quota behavior.
incident-bot: Alert PD-18273 auto-resolved (no further pages).
Aisha: Closing thread. Will post postmortem-lite in #incidents if follow-up ticket finds anything actionable. :slightly_smiling_face:
